title: A single empty tab shows the no-data message while the other tabs still show their rows
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. Open work orders exist in some tabs, but at least one tab (for example, Completed) has no work orders for the current date range and location.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Work In Progress report.
2. Open the empty tab and read its data area.
3. Open a populated tab and confirm its rows are still shown.
custom_expected:
1. The empty tab shows the no-data message "Empty bays, endless possibilities. Get Going!" and no Totals row.
2. The populated tabs still show their rows normally.
3. The empty tab's label count reads "(0)".
